summary.interpretation: Complete-ERA5-calibrated event-structure SIMEX raises lambda substantially relative to the naive 0.749768 estimate. The estimated strength of correction is measurement-error-assumption sensitive, while all three frozen sensitivity extrapolations remain below one.

claim_boundary: The complete 256-event ERA5 calibration improves source support for the sensitivity scales but does not identify a gold-standard source-specific measurement-error distribution.
SIMEX-extrapolated values are not promoted as the true latent biological lambda.
The conservative full-disagreement scenario approaches complete retention and demonstrates material uncertainty in correction magnitude.
The result supports sensitivity robustness of the phase-retention signal, not a universal or precisely corrected lambda.
The Aikens lambda outcome remains unopened.
